justification: Both surfaces appear to present a single isolated animal in profile spanning the width of the panel, with a prominent long curving line (tail/back or horn) and no other figures or framing devices, which is the strongest correspondence. However, A is a clean, smoothly modelled low-relief silhouette with a clearly legible head, body and sweeping tail, while B is a mass of short incised/pecked strokes forming an ambiguous, densely hatched shape, so the drawing conventions, degree of legibility and possibly the creature depicted differ substantially.
